//: Exists so bundlers stop here rather than walking up to cfpi/tsconfig.json.
This directory is shared: FRCDE's server imports the coverage engine from it,
and FRCDE's console imports the deadline rules. When Vite compiles one of
these files, esbuild looks for the nearest tsconfig — and CFPI's extends
'expo/tsconfig.base', which only resolves where Expo is installed. On a
deployment that installs FRCDE's dependencies alone, that lookup fails and
takes the whole build with it.
Nothing here extends anything, and the settings are the ones esbuild actually
reads. CFPI still typechecks these files through its own tsconfig, which
includes src/** and is unaffected by this file.
